voice.text: The fox wants the grapes. Which one is the word fox? Tap your guess.
All blended! Now show what you know.
Yes!
Try again.
You can crack CVC words!
Good try. Blend left to right once more.
fox — three sounds.
That is a picture, not the word.
Letters make sounds. f, o, x.
Slide them together. fff ooo x. Fox.
Never guess from a picture. Read the code.
Build fox.
Build hen.
Build dog.
Build sun.
Build hop.
Build ant.
Build cat.
Build log.
c-a-t slides into… cat, or cut, or cot
The Aesop animal: f-o-x fix, or fox, or box
h-e-n is… han, or hen, or hin
Which word has the short o of hop? sun, or dog, or hen
How do you read a secret-code word? Guess the picture, or Blend left to right, or Skip it
